description: Start a file export of analytics data of an org (org_id from analytics_orgs_list or MCP_ANALYTICS_ORG_ID): EVENTS (events of the org or project), USER_EVENTS (events of one user, user_filter.analytics_user_ids must have exactly one ID) or USERS (users with their properties). Up to 1,000,000 rows per file, is_truncated is true when more rows matched. Limits per org: one active export at a time (HTTP 409 analytics_export_already_running), 10 exports per hour (HTTP 429 analytics_export_hourly_limit), exports started with an API key: one per 10 minutes (HTTP 429 analytics_export_api_key_interval). HTTP 400 analytics_export_invalid_filter means the filter does not fit the export kind, HTTP 403 means the API key user is not a member of the org. The export runs in the background: export_status goes QUEUED -> RUNNING -> DONE or FAILED. Poll analytics_export_status until DONE or FAILED, not more often than once per ~10 seconds. When DONE, download_url is a direct link valid for 15 minutes (call analytics_export_status again for a fresh one). The file is served gzipped with Content-Encoding: gzip: a browser saves plain CSV or JSONL, from a shell use curl --compressed -o file.csv "<download_url>". Files are deleted 7 days after creation. No rows are returned through MCP, only the status and the link.

app_project_id.description: The analytics app project ID, all projects of the org if not provided

csv_delimiter.description: CSV column delimiter, comma by default

event_types_filter.description: EVENTS and USER_EVENTS only: events of any of these types, each type with its own property conditions. All event types if not provided

event_properties.description: Conditions on event properties, all of them must match

condition.description: Comparison, EQUAL by default. NOT_EQUAL and NOT_CONTAINS keep events that do not have the property at all

param_values.description: Values to compare with. EQUAL and CONTAINS match any of the values, NOT_EQUAL and NOT_CONTAINS match none of them, GREATER_THAN and LESS_THAN use the first value as a number, IS_SET and IS_NOT_SET ignore the values (pass [])

file_format.description: File format, CSV by default. JSONL is one JSON object per line

org_id.description: The analytics org ID from analytics_orgs_list (uses MCP_ANALYTICS_ORG_ID env if not provided)

time_from.description: EVENTS and USER_EVENTS only: events from this time, ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone (e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z)

time_to.description: EVENTS and USER_EVENTS only: events up to this time, ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone (e.g. 2026-10-08T00:00:00.000Z)

user_filter.description: For EVENTS: only events of the matching users. For USER_EVENTS: required, analytics_user_ids with exactly one user ID. For USERS: which users to export, all users if not provided

user_performed_event_filters.description: Only users who performed any of these events

event_properties.description: Conditions on event properties, all of them must match

condition.description: Comparison, EQUAL by default. NOT_EQUAL and NOT_CONTAINS keep events that do not have the property at all

param_values.description: Values to compare with. EQUAL and CONTAINS match any of the values, NOT_EQUAL and NOT_CONTAINS match none of them, GREATER_THAN and LESS_THAN use the first value as a number, IS_SET and IS_NOT_SET ignore the values (pass [])
